The '''Wedding of Ghes Orade and Mirta Gev''' was the private [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] wedding of [[Ghes Orade]] and [[Mirta Gev]] in [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. While no one attended the wedding but Ghes and Mirta, several Mandalorians and non-Mandalorians attended the celebratory party afterwards.
